bullets: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: FAIL when retained classic BackgroundTaskBuilder code (Windows.ApplicationModel.Background + TaskEntryPoint + .Register()) has no <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks"> in the build manifest — catches the silent dead-Register regression before scoring (verified it flags this trial).

MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Background Tasks': documented that retaining the classic model requires a windows.backgroundTasks manifest <Extension> per TaskEntryPoint plus try/catch around Register(), else the button is a silent dead control (builds + launches fine).

MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md manifest checklist: added an explicit 'carry over every UWP <Extension>' step (backgroundTasks/protocol/fileTypeAssociation/appService/shareTarget) — these are runtime activation prerequisites that were only a buried parenthetical before.
